integrity: The proof reconstructs the exact critical-point relations from the primary source, eliminates the auxiliary logarithmic derivative exactly, and combines the resulting identity only with the classical fixed-order large-zero asymptotic. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic is proved for fixed positive order and fixed cylinder phase. No uniform simultaneous large-order statement is made, and no phase-dependent next coefficient beyond the stated remainder is claimed.
title: Inverse-square convergence of sharp cylinder-function Turán minima
